parole.significato: An evergreen shrub, Atriplex canescens, found in the southwestern United States.
parole.testo: Borrowed from Spanish chamizo, from Galician chamizo.

parole.significato: A certificate of accomplishment given to pilgrims on completing an official route on the pilgramage to Camino de Santia…
parole.testo: From Spanish Compostela, from Galician Compostela, from Latin compositella (“the little well-organized one”), from composita (“put together, arranged”) + -ella (“-elle: forming diminutives”), from compōnere (“to put together”), from con- (“with, together”) + pōnere (“to put, to place”), q.v.

parole.significato: Of a style reminiscent of the architecture of Alta California.
parole.testo: Borrowed from Spanish Monterrey, from Galician Monterrei, from monte (“mountain”) + rei (“king”).
